text:
maria: Heads up — weird bundler/edge repro in the sampleapp. Dev server works but prod build (vite -> rollup plugins) causes the JS SDK to send repeated auth attempts in the browser. Steps and logs below.

maria: Repro steps (minimal):
1) git clone https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-edge-bundler-quirk
2) yarn && yarn build (vite prod + rollup plugin chain)
3) serve -s dist && open /chat
4) click "New convo" that calls /api/generate (edge lambda)

Observed: infinite spinner. Network tab: repeated POST /v1/generate with 401 then immediate retry. Token header becomes `Bearer undefined` after the first retry. Node SSR/dev mode fine. Only prod chunked build in browser.

maria: paste of console:```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 401
SDK auth: refreshToken -> got 200 -> setToken(token.0)
SDK auth: retrying request -> Authorization: Bearer undefined
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 401 (again)
```

alex: Can you paste the import lines from the edge handler and from the client code? this smells like a default vs namespace interop thing when rollup bundles ESM->CJS shims.

maria: server edge handler: ```js
import { createHandler } from '@redwood/sdk';
export default createHandler({...});
```
client code that triggers: ```js
import * as Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
await Redwood.callGenerate(...);
```

sam: aha — `import * as Redwood` often becomes a namespace object that rollup/terser can mangle in certain plugin orders. If the SDK exports a default auth helper, the namespace import might not carry the live-binding for the token setter in the browser bundle.

julie: Does switching to `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` change behavior? (quick try)

maria: tried that locally — switching to default import in client fixed it. No more undefined header; single request succeeds. So the root cause seems to be bundler-generated namespace wrapper losing the setter binding for the auth token when chunking.

alex: Can you share your vite/rollup config? the plugin ordering matters (commonjs, node-resolve, terser/minify). Also check `output.preserveModules` and `esModuleInterop`/`allowSyntheticDefaultImports` TS flags.

maria: vite.config.js has custom rollup plugin stack (we add an internal transform for svg handling). excerpt: ```js
build: {
  rollupOptions: {
    plugins: [svgPlugin(), commonjs()]
  }
}
```

sam: For a mitigation, adding `commonjs({ ignoreTryCatch: true })` won't help. The practical fixes:
- prefer default import from SDK (explicit)
- add `output.inlineDynamicImports: true` for the prod build to avoid cross-chunk live-binding issues
- or make SDK surface named exports that are pure functions (avoid mutation on module namespace)

maria: quick workaround patch: in client code replace `import * as Redwood` -> `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` and re-build. confirms fixes on our staging site.

alex: We should still fix on SDK side — ensure the auth token setter is a stable named export rather than relying on a mutable module-level object. That will be more robust across bundlers. Also add a note in the SDK docs about bundler edge caveats.

julie: Also a types issue popped up for the sampleapp: TS complains about `default` not existing on import when using `esModuleInterop: false`. We need a typing blurb: `declare module '@redwood/sdk' { export default any }` is hacky. Better: publish both named and default in d.ts.

maria: Filing issue with repro repo and adding a tiny test that builds with `vite -> rollup` and asserts token setter works in a headless browser. Will attach build trace.

ci-bot: build log snippet attached: ```
[vite] building for production...
rollup: transforming module node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js -> dist/chunk-abc123.js
created dist/chunk-abc123.js (45kb)
```

alex: Next steps:
- eng-devex to add a CI smoke test that builds sampleapp with the exact plugin order we saw. (assigning @sam)
- SDK team to export a stable `setAuthToken` named function and update README/workarounds. (assigning @alex)
- DevEx to add a note in onboarding guide about import style for edge single-file builds. (assigning @julie)

maria: thanks all — leaving repro link in the issue: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-edge-bundler-quirk (branch: prod-chunk-repro). will ping once minimal PRs land. :thumbsup:
